svg.title: Timeline 2021 to 2027
svg.desc: Timeline: advertising specialist at GIBIRNet (remote) from February 2021 to now; volunteer graphic designer at Nraphy from June 2021 to April 2024; volunteer graphic and social media at İnternet Özgürlüğü Girişimi from August 2025 to now; Information Security Technology associate degree at İstinye University from 2025, expected June 2027.
